reviewer_profile: Theory-leaning reviewer focused on crisp method objects, falsifiability, and distinctness from prior work
summary: EDO proposes emergent division-of-labor among near-homogeneous LLM agents via local delegation, recursive audit, and value-induced persona tags on sparse graphs. Vision is compelling but core algorithmic objects (Fit function, task-signature extraction, audit judgment, integration) remain unoperationalized names rather than executable procedures.
